33" corner Tivvy

25" early substitution
An injury to Jagger Cane who is replaced by Josh Bissett. Hall is in round the back, offside flag is raised.
0-0

posts.text:
Scary moment for Supermarine
A Jagger Cane strike from the edge of the area looks to have been caught by Halliday, but it comes of the top of his fingers and is just retrieved by him on the goal-line.
Then down the other end some smart handling from Smith, keeps the door closed, Supermarine were almost in. Hotly contested game this

10"
High tempo opening. Both teams zipping it about. An Aaron Wellington free kick forced Halliday into an earlier parried save.
